what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sudan in Egypt: people who have asked for protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 796517 Sudanese asylum seekers in Egypt, 84.7% of all Sudanese asylum seekers.
A much smaller group, 37684 people, was counted as Sudanese refugees in Egypt.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan from 1995 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2025, at war level from 2023.
From 2020 to 2025 the opposing groups include the RSF, the SLM/A, the SPLM/A-North and the SFA.

when.text: The figure for Egypt rose from 32761 in 2022 to 796517 in 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025, after big changes between 2022 and 2024.
Returns from Egypt to Sudan were highest in 2025 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of people whose claims had not yet been decided, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Egypt they live.
